operating_point: synth_qwen27 (24L: 6 attention + 18 DeltaNet), 15,960-token prompt (~/prompt_8k.txt) + 68,400-token prompt (~/prompt_long.txt, full length), greedy, 4-core WSL2 Ryzen 7 7735HS, argv 8 4, COLI_LOOKUP=0
patch: patch_scan_decay.py (12 anchored edits, backup engine/qwen36.c.prescan) + engine/scan_decay.h. Two-tier deterministic scan: Q36_SCAN=two-tier, window Q36_SCAN_WIN=4096, sinks Q36_SCAN_SINK=256, salience-gated 128-row blocks to 1-Q36_SCAN_EPS. Knob default full (stock bit-exact).
design_amendments: salience table = uint64 fixed-point (x 2^14), not f32: flash seeding runs under schedule(dynamic); integer sums are order-associative so the table/scan-set/ids are bit-reproducible under any scheduling

seeding = decode settle row (s==0, the one verify row that always stands -- no spec snapshot/rollback interaction) + ALL prefill chunk rows via g_q36_scan_prefill (the chunked prefill driver is the only caller with that attention() signature; a pos_base==0 gate would have seeded only chunk 1)

g1_mechanical_identity.detail: Q36_SCAN unset: id-identity vs the pre-scan binary on kv8 and tq4c1 arms at 15,960-token prompt (DUMP_IDS full streams, bit-identical)

g1_mechanical_determinism.detail: Q36_SCAN=two-tier two runs: DUMP_IDS identical, full prefill seeding active (integer table under OpenMP)

g2_ngram_self_check.detail: Every (layer, kv-head) shows IDENTICAL top blocks with values in a perfect arithmetic sequence (-2^29 per block): the salience is a pure causal-coverage gradient; iid random K rows carry zero content information. Ngram blocks landed in the EPS=0.5 set at 6/14 vs ~50% null. Measurable only on real weights (Phase 5) or a structured container (generator follow-up).

g4_speed_synthetic.verdict: NEGATIVE at eps=0.05 (documented); machinery ceiling 14x at eps=1.0
g4_speed_synthetic.detail: At 68.4k the eps=0.05 set is 45.6% of rows but returns only 1.14x: scattered block access across a 2.1 GB KV pool costs most of the linear row win, while the small mostly-contiguous window+sinks set (2.4%) reaches 14x. Real concentration (and its access pattern) is a Phase 5 real-weights question; the knob stays default full per the contract's escape hatch.

gates.g3_quality: pre-registered Phase 5 arm (wikitext-2 ppl <= +0.5% rel), unchanged

notes: attention ms/tok = the engine's [timers] attention phase; never the Speed line (prefill included there)
DeltaNet layers keep no KV rows and are skipped by the scan; debug dumps walk is_attn layers only
the qsort-per-build cost is negligible (~120k compares/token at 68k); the cost story is memory access, not selection
